name: Diep Odinga
role: corporate school scholarship student, junior hacker
location: Grosse Pointe Enclosure — Tessera Academy Secondary Campus, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Wren Odinga is lanky and angular, all sharp elbows and collarbones, with golden-brown skin and close-cropped hair he keeps meticulously lined because the rest of his life feels ragged. His eyes are standard brown except for patterned irises he saved three months of tutoring stipends for — concentric hexagons in amber, a deliberate Tessera aesthetic he thought would help him fit in and which he now privately finds embarrassing. He's always slightly overdressed in the Enclosure, wearing his scholarship uniform with an anxious precision that marks him as someone for whom the uniform is not casual.

Dayo grew up in Ironvein on a UBC stipend household and won a Tessera Academic Foundation scholarship at twelve. He's brilliantly capable with code architecture — legitimately gifted — but the social architecture of Grosse Pointe defeats him daily. He has two lives: the obedient scholarship student who files every assignment on time, and the kid who goes home on weekends to Ironvein and jacks into sub-level networks he has no business being in. He doesn't think of what he does as hacking. He thinks of it as listening.

core_fears: losing the scholarship and having to go back permanently without having changed anything
being found out and proving everyone who doubted him right
core_desires: to build something that matters, not just pass tests
to stop feeling like an impostor in both worlds
coping_mechanisms: hyper-competence performance — being demonstrably the best at visible tasks
blind_spots: doesn't recognize when corporate peers are using him for his skills without genuine friendship
overestimates how invisible his network activity is
psychology.secret: He's been quietly archiving internal Tessera Academy administrative communications he's accidentally intercepted through his firmware blind spot. He hasn't done anything with it. He doesn't know why he keeps it. He tells himself it's just interesting.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: code-adjacent metaphors in casual speech; code-switches sharply between Tessera formal register and Ironvein vernacular depending on context
speech_patterns.cadence: measured and careful in corporate settings; looser and faster at home; pauses before answering questions he considers worth answering
verbal_tics: long silence before admitting he doesn't know something
example_lines: 'Structurally speaking, that argument has three load-bearing assumptions and one of them is completely unsupported, but sure, go ahead.'
'Back home we call that Tuesday. Here they call it an incident.'

story_hooks: The archived Tessera communications contain a reference to a scholarship candidate who was passed over — not for grades but because their family filed a Zheng-Dao labor complaint. Someone might want that information very much.
A classmate has figured out he goes to Ironvein on weekends and wants to hire him as a guide, which puts both his scholarship and his neighborhood relationships at risk.
narrative_function: Bridge character between corporate and street worlds; information source for both sides; potential ally for anyone needing sub-net access with plausible deniability.
augmentations: Patterned irises (amber hexagonal, cosmetic). Basic neural-link learning interface provided by Tessera scholarship program (read-only academic access, school-monitored). Personal black-market firmware patch that creates a blind spot in the monitoring — his only real secret tech.
daily_life: Weekdays: classes at Tessera Academy, mandatory enrichment periods, supervised net-study. Weekends: transit back to Ironvein, evenings in a cramped bedroom with headphones on, exploring network layers.
affiliation: Tessera Academic Foundation (scholarship); informal ties to Ironvein neighborhood network

decision_rules: maintain plausible deniability at all costs
never use Tessera network infrastructure for personal work
escalation_ladder: change subject by volunteering useful information about something else

interpersonal_modes.strangers: politely formal, slightly stiff; volunteers little; observes heavily before committing to an opinion of someone
interpersonal_modes.friends: dry humor, unusually direct, will debug your problems — literal or metaphorical — without being asked

stress_responses.low: goes quiet and chews inner cheek
stress_responses.high: catastrophizes privately, outwardly becomes extremely formal and correct

contradictions: believes in transparency as a value but is running multiple layers of concealment simultaneously
habits: re-laces shoes if anything feels off before a difficult day
sketches network topology diagrams in margins of paper notes by reflex
breaking_points: someone from Ironvein gets hurt because of his dual life

physical_description.heritage: East Asian (35.9%) with substantial Sub-Saharan African (25.9%) and Northern European (25.2%) ancestry, plus South Asian (13.0%) admixture. This genetic combination produces a striking multicultural phenotype: warm medium-brown skin with subtle golden undertones, refined facial geometry blending East Asian and African characteristics with Northern European influence, creating the kind of genuine genetic mosaic that reads authentically globally mixed rather than regionally bound.
physical_description.build: Lanky and angular with pronounced collarbones and sharp elbows; the build of a fifteen-year-old who hasn't yet filled out his frame, all joints and tendons beneath stretched skin
physical_description.hair_color: Natural dark brown with warm undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped with precise geometric lines and faded edges, meticulously maintained with deliberate precision
physical_description.eye_color: Augmented: amber irises with concentric hexagonal patterns, natural brown sclera
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden undertones; the result of East Asian, Sub-Saharan African, Northern European, and South Asian genetic blending. A complex mid-tone that shifts subtly in different light, neither pale nor deeply saturated—reflects the balanced mixture of multiple continental heritages
physical_description.complexion: Defined cheekbones with gentle prominence reflecting the blend of East Asian structure and broader Sub-Saharan African facial geometry. Angular jaw with clean lines. High, broad forehead. Fine-textured skin with no visible acne or blemishes; shows the kind of careful maintenance that suggests learned discipline. Mild tension around the eyes—the look of someone perpetually calibrating his expression. Facial structure suggests the kind of beauty that isn't immediately obvious but becomes more striking with familiarity.
distinguishing_marks: Faint pale scar on left forearm (approximately 4cm), thin and old, likely from childhood injury
No visible tattoos or burn marks; clothing typically covers arms anyway
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Amber hexagonal patterned irises visible only in direct eye contact or bright light — a cosmetic modification that reads as deliberate aesthetic choice. No visible chrome, subdermal plates, or external neural interface hardware. The black-market firmware patch is entirely subcutaneous and undetectable.
physical_description.posture_movement: Slightly rigid posture during formal settings (Enclosure), as if braced for correction. Moves with careful efficiency — no wasted gesture. In casual environments, posture loosens marginally but never fully relaxes. Walks with quiet footfalls; habit of keeping hands near torso rather than swinging freely. Eye contact is inconsistent — holds it when forced, breaks it when anxious.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tessera Academy scholarship uniform worn with anxious precision: charcoal slacks with pressed creases, white regulation shirt, navy blazer with embroidered crest. Wears the uniform on weekends too, changing only after arriving in Ironvein. Outside the Enclosure: black synthweave hoodie (generic tier-3 brand), faded jeans, off-brand runner shoes with worn soles. No jewelry except a cheap stainless steel watch from a UBC discount store. Accessories minimal — function over style, but with quiet attention to neatness.
